auto.label: Auto
auto.help: The AI recognises the document type: exam, exam with answer key, lesson or list to learn.

exam.label: Paper exam or homework
exam.help: Faithfully copies the multiple-choice questions, keeping their original numbers. The AI only suggests an answer: you confirm each one.

exam_key.label: Exam with answer key
exam_key.help: Like the exam, but the correct answers are read from the answer key you provide. An answer missing from the key is marked "to verify".

course.label: Lesson
course.help: Writes revision questions about the lesson content.

list.label: List to learn
list.help: Vocabulary, formulas, dates, definitions: questions drawn from the list itself, without inventing items that are not in the document.

import.countAutoHelp: The AI picks the number of questions from the content (exam: all multiple-choice questions, 30 at most).
import.keyOptional: Optional. When provided, the AI reads the correct answers from it.

health.intro: Checks that the production server is ready: connection, authentication, tables, functions, realtime. This test changes nothing.

connection.fail: The server {{url}} does not answer. Check EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL in Vercel (Settings → Environment Variables), then redeploy.

frontUrl.local: The app still points to a local server ({{url}}). In Vercel, set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL to the Supabase project URL, then redeploy.

webUrl.missing: EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL is empty: set the app URL in Vercel (notification links).

email.ok: Email and password sign-in is enabled (existing parents).
email.disabled: Email sign-in is disabled: existing parents cannot sign in. Supabase → Authentication → Sign In / Providers → Email → turn on.

migrations.missingRpc: Migrations are not (all) applied: the “diagnostics” function is missing. Supabase → Database → Migrations: check the list; otherwise Project Settings → Integrations → GitHub → “Deploy to production”, then merge to main again.
migrations.forbidden: This diagnostic is for parents only.
migrations.error: The server returned an unexpected error for the “diagnostics” RPC. See Supabase → Logs → Postgres.

tables.missing: Missing tables: {{list}}. Migrations are not all applied (Supabase → Database → Migrations).

rpc.missing: Missing SQL functions: {{list}}. Migrations are not all applied (Supabase → Database → Migrations).

rls.ok: Row-level security is enabled on all tables.
rls.disabled: RLS DISABLED on: {{list}}. Danger: these tables are readable by everyone. Re-run the migrations.

publication.ok: All business tables are published to Realtime.
publication.missing: Not published to Realtime: {{list}}. Supabase → Database → Publications → supabase_realtime → add these tables.

cron.ok: Both scheduled jobs exist (request expiry, recurrence generation).
cron.missing: Missing pg_cron jobs: {{list}}. Supabase → Database → Extensions → enable pg_cron, then in SQL Editor: select public.schedule_cron_jobs();
cron.unknown: pg_cron jobs unreadable (extension not enabled?). Supabase → Database → Extensions → enable pg_cron, then in SQL Editor: select public.schedule_cron_jobs();

realtime.fail: Realtime cannot connect (state: {{status}}). Supabase → Project Settings → API: check Realtime is enabled; try another network.

functions.missing: {{name}} is NOT deployed. Supabase → Edge Functions: it must be listed. Otherwise Project Settings → Integrations → GitHub → “Deploy to production”, or run the “Deploy Edge Functions” workflow (see HUMAN_TODO).
functions.unknown: {{name}}: deployment cannot be checked from this browser (network or CORS). Check Supabase → Edge Functions.

vapid.ok: Web Push public key present (browser notifications possible).
vapid.missing: Optional: no Web Push key. Generate it below, set the public key in Vercel (EXPO_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY) and the private key in Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets.

vapidTool.title: Generate Web Push keys (VAPID)
vapidTool.body: Keys are created in your browser and are neither stored nor sent. Copy them now: never publish the private key.
vapidTool.publicLabel: Public key → Vercel: EXPO_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY and Supabase (secret VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY)

google.ok: The Google provider is enabled: parents can sign up and sign in.
google.disabled: The Google provider is DISABLED: no new parent can sign up. Supabase → Authentication → Sign In / Providers → Google → turn on, enter the Google client ID and secret → Save.
google.unknown: Cannot read the authentication settings (invalid public key or network). Check EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.

ai.ok: AI configured (OPENAI_API_KEY present). Today: {{used}}/{{limit}} generations used.
ai.notConfigured: AI NOT configured: OPENAI_API_KEY secret is missing (Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets). See HUMAN_TODO.
ai.unknown: AI status can't be checked (the generate-questions function doesn't answer).

push.unknown: Cannot check the notification sender (send-push does not answer).
push.noVapid: The server has no VAPID keys: add VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY and VAPID_SUBJECT in Supabase → Edge Functions → Secrets. See HUMAN_TODO.
push.noDevice: No device of this account is registered for notifications. Turn them on in Settings → Notifications.

errorScreen.detail: Technical detail (please include it in a report):
